sources.name: march-sw
sources.scope: opt-in Union A SW march; exact historical Gettysburg v8 only
sources.annotationMethod: Separate model-assisted fresh native image review. Manual pelvis X and row-shared ground Y uncertain by approximately ±5–8 native pixels; cap tops ±2px. One shared body reference per source; cap/sole spans remain diagnostics.
limitations: Separate model-assisted all-cell review supports limited native SW preview; not independent human, anatomical or historical certification.
Requested size and isolated edits were not exactly achieved. Final native sources were freshly reviewed and measured; no percent transformation or unchanged untargeted pixel claim.
One common source reference preserves natural posture and source variation; no action or phase-dependent size correction.
Native RGBA pixels remain unchanged. Low-alpha RGB residue is retained; the blue diagnostic is not an exhaustive fringe detector.
Other missing directions/identities, melee, casualties, recoil/settling, true bearers and complete family/production approval remain unfinished.
Actual chronological native-cell order is [0,3,2,1], with opposite contacts and alternating passing supports traced from hips through knees. The requested row-major order was not achieved.
Visible two-handed viewer-right carry is plausible. Four poses do not establish continuous planted-foot trajectories or exact historical drill.
Minimum solid padding is 64px at alpha64.
